decision_needed.recorded_as: statement line 'Taxes: Occupation' 210,616 as occupation/franchise tax; detail lines 'In lieu' as In Lieu of Tax (as in FY2023/FY2024)

notes: Governmental funds are modified cash basis (fund balances printed, no cash roll-forward); business-type funds are accrual. beginning/ending_fund_balance = Total Governmental Funds fund balances 2,084,538 / 2,648,301 (p5); cash fields null as in FY2023/FY2024 (no total governmental cash roll-forward). Note proceeds 297,215 printed among revenues (receipt line, Loan Proceeds). Transfers: Street Fund +185,108, General (20,334), Debt Service (114,958) and Other Governmental (49,816) net to '-' in the Total column; recorded gross from fund columns. Business-type receipts total = operating revenues 2,869,282 + interest income 5,599 + gain on sale 700 (p7); disbursements total 3,006,776 printed on the Statement of Activities (p2) = operating 2,967,874 + interest 38,083 + bond and loan fees 819. Business 'Other revenue' categorized charges for services because the Statement of Activities business Charges for Services (2,869,282) equals total operating revenues. Grants lines have no grantor printed (category other, detail Grants). Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position (governmental column includes capital assets and debt); component unit excluded. Statement of Activities TIF proceeds 84,846 vs funds statement 97,264 are on different bases (not a discrepancy). Proprietary noncapital financing prints only a '-' total (null). Detail: General Fund from the departments combining statement (pp15-16; the General Fund budget schedule p10 is less detailed and not recorded); Street and Debt Service from budget schedules (pp11-12); eight nonmajor funds per fund column (pp13-14); no utility budget schedules, and as in FY2023/FY2024 no business-type detail lines.
